svg.title: .SYSTEMX — AGENT 0 detailed field guide
svg.desc: Agent 0 records the project objective, coordinates canonical tasks, observes evidence, and hands acceptance to the owner. This image also lists the exact folder, example prompt, CLI surfaces, five or six process steps, and role boundary.
svg.text: Plan this task, assign one owner, collect evidence,
then ask me to review acceptance.
Agent 0 owns canonical task coordination and integration.
A task is accepted only by the designated owner; a card is evidence, not permission.
